name: zynd-companion
description: Zynd Companion: a browser extension that updates your Zynd card from the page you are on.

scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/build.mjs --api http://127.0.0.1:4777 --site http://127.0.0.1:4777 --out dist-e2e --test-host "https://*/*,http://localhost:4777/*" && playwright test
scripts.package: npm run build && cd dist && zip -qr ../zynd-companion.zip .
